scope: Pinned developer tools used by the bounded Rust CLI SBOM and dependency audit

tools.name: cargo-cyclonedx
tools.redistribution: Developer tool only; retain the upstream Apache-2.0 notice and review binary redistribution before release.
tools.transformation: Official release archive, SHA-256 verified, safely extracted without source or binary modification.
tools.provenance: Official CycloneDX GitHub release asset and pinned archive SHA-256; the archive contains the declared LICENSE file.
tools.update_procedure: Review the official release asset, license files, target, checksum, and generated SBOM before changing this pin.

tools.name: cargo-deny
tools.redistribution: Developer tool only; retain both upstream Apache-2.0 and MIT notices and review binary redistribution before release.
tools.transformation: Official release archive, SHA-256 verified, safely extracted without source or binary modification.
tools.provenance: Official cargo-deny GitHub release asset and pinned archive SHA-256; both declared license files are present in the archive.
tools.update_procedure: Review the official release asset, license files, target, checksum, and audit output before changing this pin.

advisory_database.name: RustSec advisory-db
advisory_database.policy: A local Git checkout is required; audit rejects missing or older-than-P7D HEAD revisions.
advisory_database.license: CC0-1.0 with CC-BY-4.0 for marked GHSA-derived content
advisory_database.redistribution: Developer database is not bundled. Any exported advisory text must preserve applicable license and attribution metadata, including GHSA URLs.
advisory_database.transformation: Unmodified Git checkout; audit output retains tool diagnostics. Advisory records are not copied into Kyberia core.
advisory_database.provenance: Actual clean RustSec checkout used for validation; each audit records its current immutable revision.
advisory_database.update_procedure: Explicit supply-chain-refresh fetch; verify clean checkout, freshness, license exceptions and rerun all audit groups.
